ننهاس (form VII)
# نَنْهَاسُ (nanhāsu) /nan.haː.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْهَاسَ (inhāsa)
# نَنْهَاسَ (nanhāsa) /nan.haː.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَاسَ (inhāsa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
